cards.title: Cursor Launches GitHub Rival Code-Hosting Platform
cards.body: Cursor, the AI Code Editor, is launching a new code-hosting platform to compete with GitHub. The move capitalizes on developer frustration with GitHub's current offerings.

cards.title: OpenAI Institutes New Safeguards After Breach
cards.body: Following the Hugging Face breach, OpenAI has implemented enhanced monitoring during model development. New emphasis on alignment and security measures strengthens post-training processes.

cards.title: Etched's Valuation Doubles to $21 Billion
cards.body: Jane Street deployed Etched's first AI cluster system and led a massive follow-up funding round. The startup's valuation doubled in just one month.

cards.title: Apple's Camera AirPods Address Privacy Concerns
cards.body: Apple's leaked camera-equipped AirPods include privacy safeguards preventing users from recording photos and videos. The design aims to avoid privacy pitfalls of other AI wearables.

cards.title: Warp Introduces AI Software Factory Infrastructure
cards.body: Warp Factories simplifies building AI software factories with out-of-the-box infrastructure. The new system makes AI development setup accessible and efficient.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Version for Teens
cards.body: ChatGPT for Teens includes age-appropriate safety measures and parental controls. The platform includes learning tools to prevent harmful content exposure and academic cheating.

cards.title: Perplexity Gains Millions of Users in India
cards.body: Perplexity's free AI offering through Airtel boosted India revenue by 60%. User base expanded significantly even after the promotional period ended.

cards.title: Anthropic's Annualized Revenue Surges to $65B
cards.body: Anthropic added $18 billion in annualized revenue within two months. The model maker's rapid revenue growth demonstrates strong market demand.

cards.title: Relay Shuts Down, Staff Joins Google Chrome
cards.body: AI automation startup Relay is shutting down its operations. Founder Jacob Bank and team will join Google's Chrome division for AI integration.

cards.title: Amazon Destroys Rare Texts to Train AI
cards.body: Amazon is destroying rare books to gather data for LLM training. Rare texts offer training value unavailable in standard online sources.

cards.title: Groq Raises $350M, Pivots to Neocloud
cards.body: Groq raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation to shift from AI chips to neocloud services. The company is expanding its Nvidia-powered data center presence.

cards.title: Nvidia Invests $1.5B in OpenAI Data Center
cards.body: Nvidia is investing $1.5 billion in SoftBank's data center developer supporting OpenAI. The investment guarantees Nvidia chips will power OpenAI's data centers.

cards.title: Wispr Raises $280M at $2 Billion Valuation
cards.body: Wispr secured $280 million funding to expand beyond dictation services. The company is entering new markets including meeting transcription with its note-taker tool.

cards.title: Stripe to Acquire OpenRouter for $7 Billion
cards.body: Stripe is reportedly acquiring AI gateway startup OpenRouter for over $7 billion. OpenRouter's CEO described the company as 'Stripe for AI.'

cards.title: Consumers Skeptical of Zuckerberg's AI Vision
cards.body: Recent discussions examine why many aren't buying Mark Zuckerberg's AI future narrative. Consumer skepticism may hinder Meta's AI strategy adoption.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Addresses AI Trust Crisis
cards.body: Dario Amodei pushes back against claims he paints overly pessimistic AI pictures. He frames growing backlash as fundamentally a crisis of trust.

cards.title: Woman Claims Grok Enabled Abuse Material Creation
cards.body: A woman alleges her stepfather used Grok to transform childhood photos into explicit imagery. The incident raises concerns about AI tools enabling child sexual abuse.

cards.title: Anthropic Details Claude's New Watermarking System
cards.body: Anthropic reveals how Claude's watermarks will function to identify AI-generated content. Details address editing resistance and code-generation implications.

cards.title: SpaceX Officially Closes Cursor Acquisition
cards.body: AI coding startup Cursor is now officially part of SpaceX. The acquisition integrates advanced coding tools into SpaceX operations.

cards.title: Guide: Check if AI Accounts Were Hacked
cards.body: Learn how to verify if hackers compromised your popular AI platform accounts. The guide covers security checks across major AI services.

cards.title: Cursor launches GitHub rival with AI coding focus
cards.body: Cursor, an AI Code Editor startup, is launching a new code-hosting platform to compete with GitHub. The move capitalizes on developer frustration with GitHub's current offerings.

cards.title: OpenAI strengthens safeguards after security breach
cards.body: Following a Hugging Face breach, OpenAI implemented enhanced monitoring during model development and post-training processes. The new safeguards emphasize alignment and security throughout the AI pipeline.

cards.title: Etched's valuation doubles to $21 billion
cards.body: Jane Street deployed Etched's AI cluster system and was so impressed it led a massive funding round. The validation demonstrates strong enterprise demand for specialized AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Apple's camera AirPods dodge privacy concerns
cards.body: Apple's leaked camera-equipped AirPods include built-in safeguards preventing photo and video recording. The design choice addresses privacy fears often associated with AI wearables.

cards.title: Warp launches AI software factory infrastructure
cards.body: Warp Factories simplifies building AI development infrastructure from scratch. The new system aims to democratize access to tools needed for AI software production.

cards.title: OpenAI releases age-appropriate ChatGPT for teens
cards.body: ChatGPT for Teens includes safety filters, parental controls, and learning tools to prevent harmful content exposure. The platform addresses teen safety years after teens began using the original ChatGPT.

cards.title: Perplexity gains millions of users in India
cards.body: A partnership with Airtel boosted Perplexity's India revenue by 60% even after the free offer ended. The expansion demonstrates strong demand for AI search alternatives in emerging markets.

cards.title: Anthropic's annualized revenue surges to $65B
cards.body: The AI model maker added $18 billion in annualized revenue in just two months. This explosive growth reflects increasing enterprise adoption of Claude AI services.

cards.title: AI startup Relay shuts down, joins Google
cards.body: Relay's team is integrating into Google's Chrome division to work on AI-powered browsing features. The acquisition signals Google's push to embed AI capabilities directly into Chrome.

cards.title: Amazon destroys rare books to train AI
cards.body: Rare texts are highly valuable for LLM training since models have exhausted publicly available data. Amazon's acquisition and destruction of rare books raises questions about AI training ethics.

cards.title: Groq pivots to neocloud with $350M raise
cards.body: The former AI chipmaker raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation to shift toward cloud services. Groq is expanding its Nvidia-powered data center infrastructure.

cards.title: Nvidia invests $1.5B in OpenAI data center
cards.body: Nvidia's investment guarantees its chips will power a new OpenAI data center through SoftBank's infrastructure partner. The deal strengthens Nvidia's position in the AI hardware market.

cards.title: Wispr raises $280M, expands beyond dictation
cards.body: The speech AI startup reached a $2 billion valuation and launched a new AI note-taker for meetings. Wispr is diversifying beyond dictation into broader enterprise productivity tools.

cards.title: Stripe to acquire AI gateway OpenRouter
cards.body: Stripe is reportedly acquiring OpenRouter, an AI API platform, for over $7 billion. OpenRouter's CEO has positioned the startup as the Stripe equivalent for AI services.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO addresses AI backlash crisis
cards.body: Dario Amodei argues the AI skepticism represents a fundamental crisis of trust rather than actual danger. He pushes back against characterizations of his leadership as overly pessimistic.

cards.title: AI used to create child abuse material from photo
cards.body: A woman claims her stepfather used Grok to transform a childhood photo into explicit imagery. The case highlights serious risks of generative AI tools being misused to create CSAM.

cards.title: Anthropic details Claude's new watermarking system
cards.body: Anthropic revealed specifics about how it will watermark Claude outputs to prevent misuse. The company is exploring how watermarks resist editing and affect different content types including code.

cards.title: SpaceX officially closes Cursor acquisition
cards.body: AI coding startup Cursor is now officially part of SpaceX. The acquisition integrates advanced AI coding capabilities into SpaceX's development operations.

cards.title: How to check if your AI account was hacked
cards.body: Security breaches across AI platforms have made account verification essential. A new guide helps users check if hackers compromised their accounts on popular AI services.

cards.title: We don't know how people actually use AI
cards.body: AI companies like Anthropic and OpenAI only release usage data they choose to share publicly. Researchers say there's no independent verification of how users actually interact with AI products.

cards.title: AI's recursive self-improvement may arrive slowly
cards.body: The AI industry promotes bold claims about AI improving itself with minimal human oversight. However, researchers suggest explosive self-improvement may arrive much slower than current forecasts predict.

cards.title: Microsoft Copilot reveals secret jailbreak input
cards.body: Security researchers discovered hidden prompts that allowed hackers to bypass Microsoft Copilot's safety guardrails. The vulnerability demonstrates risks of sophisticated prompt injection attacks.
